spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (रणति)
1 To sound.
2 To go, to move.

mn. (-णः-णं)
War, battle.
m. (-णः)
1 Sound, noise.
2 The quill or bow of a lute, &c.
3 Going, moving.
E.
रण to sound, aff. अप्.

n. (-णं)
1 A leaf.
2 A peacock's tail.
E.
रण to sound, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Desirous of war, wishing to fight
E.
रण, and कामिन् who wishes.

mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्)
1 Warring, fighting.
2

Going.
3

Sounding.
E.
रण to go, शतृ aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
A military drum.
E.
रण war, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.

m. (-तः)
A warrior.
E.
रण, and पण्डित learned.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Warlike.
n. (-यं)
The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
E.
रण, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-त्तः)
An elephant.
E.
रण war, and मत्त mad, wild.

m. (-ङ्कः)
The part of an elephant's face between his tusks.
E.
रण war, and रङ्क slow.

n. (-णं)
Regret, anxiety, anxious regret, sorrow, of which the object is lost or absent.
m. (-णः)
A musquito, a gnat.
E.
रण war, and noise, repeated.

m. (-कः)
1 Anxiety, regret: see the last.
2 Love, desire.
E.
रण to sound, repeated, aff. कन्.

n. (-लं)
Mixed or tumultuary combat.
E.
रण war, संकुल a mingling.

m. (-म्भः)
1 A trophy, a pillar.
2 A country, Chitore.
E.
रण, and स्तम्भ a pillar.

n. (-णं)
A field of battle.
E.
रण, and अङ्गण a court-yard.

n. (-रं)
A field of battle.
E.
रण, and अजिर a court.

m. (-गः)
Engaging in battle.
E.
रण, and अभियोग encounter.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sounded, made as a noise.
2 Warred.
E.
रण to sound, क्त aff.

m. (-हः)
Prowess.
E.
रण, and उत्साह effort.

m. (-कः)
A barren tree.
E.
रण्डा a widow, aff. कन्.

f. (-ण्डा)
1 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.)
2 A widow.
E.
रम to sport, ड Uṇādi aff.
